newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-DYNAMO EDGE ALANIA 1-0 TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DYNAMO EDGE ALANIA 1-0 TO GO TOP.

text.p: A goal on the stroke of half-time from former Real Betis midfielder Andrei Kobelev gave Dynamo Moscow a 1-0 home win over Alania Vladikavkaz on Saturday which put them on top of the league for the first time this season.

In a title race where the leadership has changed hands several times in the first two months, previous leaders Rotor Volgograd dropped two points with a scoreless draw at bottom club Fakel Voronezh. They now trail Dynamo by a point.

Champions Spartak Moscow and early season pacemakers Rostselmash Rostov were held to draws, Spartak 1-1 away in Kaliningrad and Rostov 1-1 at home to Torpedo Moscow. Both share third place, three points off the pace.

Saturday's defeat adds to mounting problems for Caucasus-based Alania, the 1995 champions and runners-up last year, who now lag behind in ninth place. The pressure is on coach Valery Gazzayev to turn around the best supported club in the league.

He is not alone, however. CSKA Moscow, under former Russia coach Pavel Sadyrin, went down 2-0 away to lowly Tyumen and Zenit St Petersburg, led by former Soviet trainer Anatoly Byshovets, slumped to a 3-0 defeat at home to strugglers KamAZ.
